articles.title: Helsing built an AI system that prepares targets for weapons systems and says every decision will carry a human name
articles.summary: Helsing has unveiled Clarity, an AI platform that uses agents to distill sensor data into target recommendations for weapons systems, all under human oversight and European control. But experience from the Iran war, Gaza, and a near-miss involving China shows that the speed of automation and data fusion create risks that are hard to contain. articles.title: Google’s Gemini Targets Health Care’s Data Problem
articles.summary: Google Cloud is launching Gemini for Health Care, an AI platform designed to connect fragmented information across hospitals, insurers and other health systems while reducing administrative work. Aashima Gupta, Global Leader of Healthcare at Google Cloud, discusses how Gemini can connect medical records, clinical guidelines and business systems, and how Google is building privacy, security and HIPAA compliance into the platform. She joins Riley Griffin on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
